name: ularn-3d
description: Ularn — The Caves Below, an offline dungeon adventure
author: Ularn contributors

scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:win:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:win:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:win:zip: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --dir --publish never
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node --test tests/desktop-protocol.unit.mjs && node tests/desktop-smoke.mjs
